title: How Madrid built its metro cheaply (2024)
summary: This article examines how Madrid successfully built an extensive metro system at a remarkably low cost compared to other major cities, exploring the engineering decisions, urban planning strategies, and political will that enabled this achievement.
problem_solved: It explains how Madrid achieved affordable metro construction when most cities struggle with escalating transit costs.
why_valuable: Provides valuable lessons for cities worldwide on how to build cost-effective public transit systems without sacrificing quality or coverage.
